messages:
June (People Ops): Quick thread because we've seen inconsistent entries for people who were on leave, joined mid-cycle, or converted from contractors. Want to lock down a small set of flags and an exception workflow. Thoughts?
Omar (Manager - Data): Yes please. My team had one engineer who converted to FTE mid-cycle and I wasn't sure whether to rate them as contractor or FTE for earlier months.
Priya (Manager - Product): Same. Also had a PM on parental leave for 10 weeks. I left notes but didn't have a standard label to make calibration easy.
June (People Ops): Proposed fields on the manager form: 1) Category dropdown: Full cycle / Partial (LOA) / New hire <90d / Contractor->FTE / Insufficient data. 2) Required 1-line rationale. 3) Flags: "Flag for calibration", "PIP during cycle" (non-public), "Requested extension". 4) Evidence links (0-5). We'll prefill dates from HRIS when available.
Raj (HRBP): Operational details: - LOA heuristic: >30% of the review window -> Partial (LOA). - Contractor->FTE: record conversion date; calibration will treat pre-conversion work as contractor-period contribution. - Provisional ratings are allowed but must be flagged.
Omar (Manager - Data): For "Insufficient data" what happens in calibration? Do we exclude or discuss?
June (People Ops): "Insufficient data" entries show in packet with a short rationale and are queued for a short oral note during calibration; they are not auto-scored. Calibration will recommend a path (defer, provisional, or use manager input).
Priya (Manager - Product): Can managers request more time if their reports are on emergency leave and forms can't be completed by deadline?
Raj (HRBP): Yes, managers can request a 7-day extension via the Helpdesk link on the forms page. For urgent exceptions, escalate to your HRBP and mark "Requested extension" on the form so People Ops can triage.
PeopleOps Bot: Reminder: Review forms due in 72 hours. Form link: https://docs.internal/redwood/reviews/forms. Extensions: https://helpdesk.internal/redwood/leave-extensions :bell: 
Omar (Manager - Data): One small UX ask: can the dropdown auto-check the "Flag for calibration" if LOA or Contractor->FTE is selected? That would avoid missed flags.
June (People Ops): Good idea. We'll auto-check the calibration flag for Partial (LOA) and Contractor->FTE, but allow unchecking if manager explicitly confirms a full evaluation. We will also add inline help text near the rating field explaining "When to mark provisional vs final".
Priya (Manager - Product): Great. Last thing: will the HRIS prefill require manager confirmation? I don't want stale HRIS dates accidentally saved.
June (People Ops): Yes, prefilled dates will be editable and require a short confirmation checkbox before submission.
June (People Ops): I'll patch the form tonight and send a short digest to managers with a 5-slide PDF and an exemplar form filled for each case. DM me if you want a 5-min walkthrough before the update goes live. :slightly_smiling_face:
